blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Rep. Chel Diokno, a House prosecutor in Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial, declined to predict a holiday conclusion for the proceedings. “It’s very hard to predict. I hope that the entire litigation will be done by then, but I really can’t say for sure,” Diokno said in an interview on Monday with Karen Davila, anchor of the ANC program “Headstart.” According to a prosecution statement issued on Tuesday, the trial may extend beyond the Christmas break, with prosecutors acknowledging that its conclusion and the eventual votes of senator-judges remain uncertain despite their confidence in the evidence already presented.
